name: @raea/r3f
description: React Three Fiber both ways (docs/r3f.feature): <R3F> draws an R3F scene with raea, <Raea> and the three.js host (src/three) draw raea's 3D in R3F or any three.js app, loadShapes meshes raea's solids for them (tools/shape-wasm.sh).
//: In a project, three and @react-three/fiber are its own (raea add three@0.185.0 @react-three/fiber@9.8.2): the bundler resolves them from the project, so a scene and raea share one copy. Here, for the package's tests and tsc, React is the SDK's own (sdk/raea), linked; sdk/playable's bundler resolves three to its own copy, so a playable carries one.
